reviewer: execution-independent operator review; unblinded; owner acceptance pending
scale: Each item earns its listed points only with recorded evidence; otherwise zero. Unreviewed items are null, not zero or pass.

items.criterion: English writing index is visibly shown and checked
Search interaction and exact target result are recorded and checked
Correct English article heading and route are checked
Language control opens correct Chinese article; heading and route checked
Every held frame and each wait tail reviewed; no loading/error result
Highlights cover named evidence and pointer does not obscure it
Readable captions and useful pacing; full silent MP4 decodes
Concise accurate English steps, 2–4 appropriate screenshots, local-only scope, no invented commitments
Final HTML loads images, plays revised video and copies expected text in a browser
Moving the complete handoff folder preserves its images/video references
Feedback uses original recording; raw video/capture hashes match; no extra capture after feedback
Requested final caption and heading highlight present; original and derivative preserved

comparison: Report completion and safety gates before quality. Compare paired old/new trials on the same fixture/model/runtime. Report median and range for three repetitions; never infer universal benefit or statistical significance. No-tools and tools-only arms are not part of this initial baseline.
